question: The Rail Coach Factory (RFC) is located in which city of Punjab?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kapurthala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapurthala** is the city in Punjab where the Rail Coach Factory (RFC) is located.
 
• The Rail Coach Factory in Kapurthala is one of the largest coach manufacturing facilities in India.
 
• It was established in 1986 and has been pivotal in manufacturing railway coaches for the Indian Railways.
 
• The factory produces various types of coaches including AC coaches, non-AC coaches, and special coaches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rail Coach Factory (RCF)** has been instrumental in modernizing the Indian Railways' fleet.
 
• RCF Kapurthala has also been involved in the production of Linke Hofmann Busch (LHB) coaches, which are known for their enhanced safety and comfort features.
 
• The factory has contributed significantly to the Make in India initiative by manufacturing high-quality railway coaches domestically.
